classes.description: ERP Bill of Materials — 从 ERP 系统下载到 InSite 的 BOM，由外部系统（如 SAP）控制和管理。与原生 BOM 不同，ERPBOM 包含 ERP 路由步骤引用，其物料行使用独立的 BOMMaterialListItem 类型存储在专用表中。标记为 externallyControlled，编辑和更新受限制。 【Swagger】Schema: ERPBOMEntity；来源文件: ERPBOMs.json；API: /api/ERPBOMs。

properties.name: setupAccess
properties.description: 换线设置权限 → SetupAccess 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: changeHistory
properties.description: 关联的变更历史记录（ChangeStatus）。 【Swagger】引用 Schema: ChangeHistoryChanges。

properties.name: erpbomBase
properties.description: ERPBOM 基线引用 → ERPBOM

properties.name: description
properties.description: ERP BOM 的描述说明 【Swagger】Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

properties.name: iconId
properties.description: 关联图标的标识符。 【Swagger】Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance

properties.name: revision
properties.description: ERP BOM 版本号（必填） 【Swagger】Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

properties.name: wipMsgDefMgr
properties.description: WIP消息定义管理器 → WIPMsgDefMgr 【Swagger】引用 Schema: WIPMsgEntity。

properties.name: billType
properties.description: BOM 类型（如 Manufacturing, Engineering） 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: status
properties.description: 确定实例当前状态（Active/In-Active），有效值：1=Active，2=Inactive。 【Swagger】Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive Note there are no validations (rules enforced) concerning active vs. inactive revisions.

properties.name: externallyControlled
properties.description: 是否由外部系统（ERP）控制，ERPBOM 始终为 true 【Swagger】Indicates that this object is controlled externally from InSite and updates/edits should be controlled or restricted within InSite

properties.name: notes
properties.description: 内部备注 【Swagger】Notations and comments associated with this object.

properties.name: eco
properties.description: 工程变更单号 【Swagger】Engineering Change Order

properties.name: filterTags
properties.description: 分类筛选标签 【Swagger】FilterTags comma seperated list

properties.name: erpRouteBase
properties.description: ERP工艺路线基线引用

properties.name: erpRoute
properties.description: 关联的 ERP 工艺路线（ERP Route/Step），定义物料在哪个工序消耗 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。

classes.description: BOMMaterialListItem — ERP BOM 中的物料行，与原生 ProductMaterialListItem 类似但存储在独立的表中。由 ERP 系统创建并下载到 InSite，包含 ERP 路由步骤信息。每个物料行指定一种物料、需求数量和发行控制策略。 【Swagger】Schema: BOMMaterialListItemChanges；来源文件: ERPBOMs.json；API: /api/ERPBOMs。

properties.name: isSourceProduct
properties.description: 物理字段 IsSourceProduct 【Swagger】Flag indicating whether the Product should be used as the source material to build the target Product.

properties.name: ssWorkflow
properties.description: 物理字段 ss_WorkflowId → Workflow

properties.name: scsIsComponentIssue
properties.description: 物理字段 scsIsComponentIssue 【Swagger】Flag to denote if the material is to be consumed via CEP Component Issue or SCS Material Consumption logic

properties.name: ssStep
properties.description: 物理字段 ss_StepId → WorkflowStep

properties.name: ssWfStackKey
properties.description: 物理字段 ss_WfStackKey

properties.name: isImage
properties.description: 图像引用 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。

properties.name: uom2
properties.description: 辅助计量单位 → UOM

properties.name: issueControl
properties.description: 发行控制：1=Serial, 2=Bulk, 3=Quantity&Lot, 4=FloorStock, 5=Quantity, 6=DisplayOnly 【Swagger】1 - Container is tracked in InSite at the serial level 2 - Container is tracked in InSite at the bulk level 3 - Container is not tracked in InSite ... quantity and lot is recorded 4 - non lot controlled ( floor stock ) location is recorded no container 5 - recording quantities but not container or location 6 - issue quantities are displayed but not recorded

properties.name: phantomBill
properties.description: 虚拟件引用的下层 ERP BOM → ERPBOM 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。

properties.name: qtyRequired
properties.description: 需求数量（必填） 【Swagger】Quantity of this component item required.

properties.name: qty2Required
properties.description: 辅助数量 【Swagger】Quantity of this component item required, if multiple quantities are being tracked.

properties.name: referenceDesignator
properties.description: 装配位号 【Swagger】The specific position on or in the assembly where this item is placed.

properties.name: routeStep
properties.description: 指派的 ERP 工步/RouteStep 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedSubentityRef。

properties.name: scrapPercent
properties.description: 预期报废百分比 【Swagger】Percent of this item expected to be scrapped.

properties.name: setupQty
properties.description: 物理字段 SetupQty 【Swagger】The amount of this component item needed to initialize the processing resource.

properties.name: uom
properties.description: 主计量单位 → UOM 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: effectiveThruDateGmt
properties.description: 物理字段 EffectiveThruDateGMT

properties.name: vendorControl
properties.description: 物理字段 VendorControl 【Swagger】Denotes whether Vendor information is required for this item.

properties.name: setupQty2
properties.description: 物理字段 SetupQty2 【Swagger】The amount of this component item needed to initialize the processing resource.

properties.name: isPhantom
properties.description: 是否为虚拟件 【Swagger】Denotes this is a phantom material list item. Phantom items are not actual materials, but are artifical constructs added from grouping component items in a BOM structure to reduce BOM maintenance.

properties.name: isEnabled
properties.description: 物理字段 IsEnabled

properties.name: allowSubstitution
properties.description: 是否允许使用替代料 【Swagger】Allow substitution of the product to be issued.

properties.name: effectiveFromDate
properties.description: 生效开始日期 【Swagger】If specified, this is the starting date and time when this Path Selector becomes available.

properties.name: effectiveFromDateGmt
properties.description: 物理字段 EffectiveFromDateGMT

properties.name: effectiveThruDate
properties.description: 生效截止日期 【Swagger】If specified, this is the ending date and time when this Bin becomes no longer available.

properties.name: erpReportingFlag
properties.description: 物理字段 ERPReportingFlag 【Swagger】Used to indicate if this component needs to have actual qty reported back to ERP or if a backflush will occur within the ERP that does not require this to be reported.

properties.name: defaultStockPoint
properties.description: 物理字段 DefaultStockPoint 【Swagger】If the component needs to be pulled from a specific location within the Inventory System, this would indicate it.

properties.name: defaultLot
properties.description: 物理字段 DefaultLot 【Swagger】If a specific lot/batch of the component needs to be issued, this would indicate the lot/batch indicator to be issued

properties.name: erpLineItem
properties.description: 物理字段 ERPLineItem 【Swagger】indicates the Line indicator within the BOM structure from the ERP that uniquely identifies this line item

properties.name: subFactory
properties.description: 物理字段 SubFactory 【Swagger】used to indicate if this component needs to be pulled from a specific bucket of inventory.

properties.name: allowUnderConsumption
properties.description: 物理字段 AllowUnderConsumption 【Swagger】This flag determines if the material consumption check will allow less materials to be issued than specified in the MaterialListItem entry

properties.name: allowOverConsumption
properties.description: 是否允许超发料 【Swagger】This flag determines if the material consumption check will allow more materials to be issued than specified in the MaterialListItem entry

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 物理字段 IsFrozen 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

properties.name: erpbom
properties.description: 物理字段 ERPBOMId → ERPBOM

properties.name: name
properties.description: 物料行名称 【Swagger】Unique name for the name subentity.

properties.name: adjustmentValue
properties.description: 自动调整数值 【Swagger】This field defines the value used for auto-adjustments calculations based on the chosen Adjustment Type.

properties.name: adjustmentType
properties.description: 调整类型 【Swagger】This field defines the type of the adjustment (e.g. Percentage or Quantity). The chosen type determines how the AdjustmentValue is interpreted and applied for the auto-adjustment calculations.

properties.name: qtyIssued
properties.description: 物理字段 QtyIssued 【Swagger】Material quantity (individual) that has been issued for the item

properties.name: allowAllRevisionsAsSubstitute
properties.description: 物理字段 AllowAllRevisionsAsSubstitute 【Swagger】When true it will allow all revisions of the product to be allowed for the material requirement

properties.name: assemblySequence
properties.description: 装配顺序 【Swagger】Sequence the item should be assembled. The value is only used if the item is assigned to a Step/Spec

properties.name: description
properties.description: 物理字段 Description 【Swagger】Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

properties.name: objectTypeName
properties.description: 物理字段 ObjectTypeName 【Swagger】Generic String

properties.name: parentRevision
properties.description: 物理字段 ParentRevision 【Swagger】Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

properties.name: producingOrder
properties.description: 物理字段 ProducingOrder 【Swagger】Producing Order is a String field

properties.name: productBase
properties.description: 产品基线引用

properties.name: product
properties.description: 关联的产品/物料 → Product 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。
